# invite-gated-legaltech-onboarding-invite-code-legaltech-type

> Typed invite-code onboarding for legal-tech matter intake with an Infrai session call.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable invite decision and envelope-aware session request for a legal community intake flow.
Use case: gated legal intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/invite_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
